headline: TIDAL RUSH rung 3: storms now arrive as squalls
lede: The bay's per-lap swell re-roll stopped being a crossfade. A squall front now travels across STORM BAY — behind it the new sea, ahead of it the old, and the CPU hull rides the exact mix the shader draws. Every ski also drags Wave-Race's solid white ribbon wake, and landed tricks bank their hang-time with an air-time bonus.

notes.text: Squall front: new seas sweep in along the swell direction (34 m band, ~10 s crossing); drawn ≡ rider parity extends across the transition via a two-slot GLSL twin of the CPU mix — pinned exact at 1e-12.
Ribbon wake per hull — speed-reactive stitched strip, WR64's signature trail — plus split racing lines for MAKO and TUNDRA.

tidalcheck 51→70 pins (front spatial law, GLSL twin, air-bonus math, determinism through the squall); new mutants judge/swell/front all die; new tidaldrive wins P1 in headless Chrome with real key/tap events.
Two HUD bugs fixed on the way: the score box had shown 0 since rung 1, and GO could hang on screen at low frame rates.
